verdict.rationale: Stripe Terminal SDKs and server-driven integrations come with a built-in simulated card reader, allowing developers to build and test full payment flows without connecting to physical hardware or touching production data, and Stripe's broader test-mode/sandbox conventions apply across the API. missing for 10: no independent/hands-on report confirming the simulated reader fully mirrors production behavior, and no explicit mention of sandbox test-mode API keys specific to Terminal in this pack.
